The '''Drall Hollow''' was was an area of the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat Swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the ninth piece of terrain that the contestants of the [[Agrilat Swamp Circuit]] had to race through.<ref name="SWG:AST" />
